definition: A hypothetical country exports $180 billion of goods and $85 billion of services, while importing $235 billion of goods and $58 billion of services. What are total net exports, in billions of dollars?
explanation: Net exports = goods exports + services exports − goods imports − services imports = 180 + 85 − 235 − 58 = -28 billion dollars. A negative result is a trade deficit.

definition: At free-trade prices, a finished unit sells for $200.00 and requires $100.00 of imported inputs. Hypothetical tariffs of 12% on the output and 3% on inputs fully raise their domestic prices; input quantities are unchanged. What is the effective protection rate for domestic value added?
explanation: Free-trade value added = 200 − 100 = 100. Protected value added = 200(1 + 12/100) − 100(1 + 3/100) = 121.00. Effective protection = (121.00 − 100)/100 × 100 = 21.00%.
